age.evidence: Female C57Bl/6 mice (20 g; Charles River) — only body weight given, no age stated

sex.evidence: Female C57Bl/6 mice (20 g; Charles River) were housed in the Life Sciences Research Institute Animal Care Facility

dosing.evidence: Mice were euthanized 0.25, 4, 24, or 72 hr following oral administration of vehicle (150 µL) or ibogaine (100 mg/kg)

group_housing.evidence: not reported; paper states only that mice 'were housed in the Life Sciences Research Institute Animal Care Facility at Dalhousie University'

judge_notes: All three candidates agree: no behavioural assays were conducted. The paper contains in vitro work (Seahorse XFe96 extracellular flux, RT-qPCR, TMRM/MitoSOX fluorescence microscopy in primary neuron/astrocyte cultures and C8-B4 microglia) and in vivo ex vivo molecular endpoints (mass spectrometric ibogaine pharmacokinetics, spinal cord proteomics with IPA). All of these are excluded by the rubric, so the assays list is empty.

Dosing: one acute oral dose of ibogaine (100 mg/kg) was given to female mice. The vehicle volume (150 µL) is stated but its identity is not, so vehicle is not_reported. The PBS stock applies only to the in vitro cell culture work.
Housing: ad libitum food and water is stated. Handling, cage density, light-cycle direction and enrichment are not reported.
DOI: not present in the markdown and no candidate supplied one, so it is set to null. study_id Oulton2025 is the modal value across candidates.
